notes: City of Laredo, TX (Webb County), within city limits. Built by data/jurisidictions/run_laredo.py (webb_county.py, shared runner tx_multicounty.py). 78,791 parcels, $10.68B land. All values 2026.

Values: Webb County Appraisal District's 2026 certified export (PACS 8.0.33, exported 2026-08-06; downloaded by hand). Geometry: TxGIO StratMap 2026 land parcels for Webb County (collected from Webb CAD 2026-08-01), joined on prop_id. Check: Webb CAD's taxable land on City of Laredo accounts (C1) is $10.90B vs $10.68B mapped here (98%); the rest is on accounts with no 2026 polygon.
City limits: Census TIGER/Line 2025 place 4841464; the City of Laredo entity (C1) agrees on all but 61 / 85 accounts.
Exempt land dropped: the roll's EX flags (EX-XV etc.; every named public owner carries one): 2,804 records. 205 utility records left off.

Condos and undivided interests: 1,613 undivided-interest groups summed; 3,278 condo / townhome units in 226 developments merged onto their land. StratMap draws commercial condo units (office and retail plazas) as unit outlines; where the merged hull is smaller than the lot the units share, the units' summed roll acreage is used (161 developments; e.g. Southview Professional Plaza: 1.70 ac, $14/sqft). 22 remain 5-8x their neighbours.
Land size: on 464 parcels the polygon is a fragment of the roll's acreage and the appraiser's area is used; 193 slivers hidden.
Singularity sweep: outside the commercial condo units above, every flagged parcel is at most 7x its neighbourhood or a hidden sliver.
Under 100k parcels: browser GeoParquet path, no PMTiles bake.

Parking is OSM delivered through Overture Maps (release 2026-10-21.0, --overture-only), classified surface vs structure: 169 lots, 82.7 acres, $35.3M est. land value. OSM parking coverage in Laredo is thin, so this undercounts. apply_parking_category.py tagged 24 parcels 'Parking Lot'.
Links: Webb CAD's property page pinned to 2026 (webbcad.org/property-detail/<prop_id>/2026; confirmed by the user).

Satellite-detected parking (beta, dev): DINOv2 model fine-tuned on 175 hand-labelled Laredo squares, NAIP 2022 0.6 m, threshold 0.6 plus precision rules. On 150 blind random squares: 95% precision, 70% recall (deliberate undercount); calibrated citywide surface parking 30.8 +/- 2.0 km2 vs 21.7 km2 mapped. Shown via the parking page's source switch; per-lot evidence in data/scripts/parking_evidence.py, validation in data/scripts/parking_validation/laredo.json.
